one-number-travels.author: this project
one-number-travels.license: in-house, authored here — no third-party licence and nothing to attribute
one-number-travels.note: Two IDENTICAL tokens: one multiplies, one does not. Draws REACH, never magnitude — the kicker over it reads BOTH ARE TRUE, and s17 already draws the 37.8/1.1 magnitudes to scale. Copy count is 22 on purpose: not 30 or 34, so a countable spread cannot be read as the published 'more than 30 times' ratio. Carries --warn for the figure that travels; re-colour at the generator, not with tint.py.
